title: Cyaxares rules the Medes
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Dated only by the Generations books cited below; no tier 1–4 chronology covers this event.

chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.106 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 49 (PDF p. 51)
chronologies.note: DERIVED (not Herodotus's figure): 635/634 BC − 40 = 595/594 BC for the death of Cyaxares (anchor CFAH AP-32, via 1.102).
